items.title: PhD and postdoc positions in the MIND-MAP project
items.where: Department of Software Engineering, FNSPE, Czech Technical University in Prague
items.note: Geometry-informed topological data analysis, PDE and deep-learning segmentation of microglia in 3D + time microscopy. One PhD and one postdoc position, funded for three years; supervised by Jooyoung Hahn, with partners in Warsaw and at ISTA.

facts.label: Positions
facts.value: One PhD and one postdoc, funded for three years, 2027–2029

facts.label: Express interest
facts.value: PhD: by 5 December 2026 — a CV and a few lines on your research interests. Postdoc: a CV and a short research summary. To jooyoung.hahn (A T) fjfi.cvut.cz; say which position you aim for

facts.label: Pay
facts.value: Postdoc 70,000 CZK gross per month (full time). PhD 38,745 CZK gross per month (0.8 FTE) + 12,000 CZK tax-free doctoral stipend, about 43,000 CZK net

items.title: PhD and postdoc positions in the MIND-MAP project, University of Warsaw
items.where: University of Warsaw — with Paweł Dłotko
items.note: Two funded openings on the Warsaw side of the same project: topological descriptors of cell shapes that change in time, shape trajectories and Ball Mapper visualization. Apply to Paweł Dłotko, who supervises these positions; the flyer gives his contact address.

facts.label: Positions
facts.value: One PhD and one postdoc, funded for three years, 2027–2029

facts.label: Express interest
facts.value: A CV and a few lines on your background and research interests, to p.dlotko (A T) uw.edu.pl; say which position you aim for

facts.label: Official call
facts.value: Formal recruitment and eligibility criteria announced separately
